stories.title: Create BEV C04 Knowledge Assessment with Electric Drivetrain Fault Scenarios
stories.description: Build comprehensive KA document for C04 (Electric Drivetrain Systems) with scenario-based diagnostic questions covering motor diagnostics, controller failures, and efficiency testing aligned to NOSS CoCU C04 learning outcomes.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md created at bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md with minimum 25 scenario-based questions across 5 fault categories (motor, controller, drive shaft, efficiency, safety)
Answer scheme embedded with diagnostic decision trees showing expected reasoning paths and mark allocation per question
Assessment rubric includes 4 competency levels (Not Yet, Partial, Competent, Advanced) with evidence criteria for each level
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md (markdown content ~800 words including header box per Buku Panduan WIM format)
File to reference: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KP*.md for content alignment and technical terminology
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_bev_c04_ka_structure.py -v (validates: min 25 questions, decision tree presence, 4 rubric levels)

stories.title: Create BEV C02 Performance Assessment with Battery Management System Competency Rubric
stories.description: Build PA document for C02 with practical assessment covering BMS diagnostics, cell voltage data interpretation, charging system corrective actions, and supervisor sign-off criteria aligned to NOSS C02 work activities.
acceptanceCriteria: PA.md created at bev-diagnostic-rectification/C02/PA.md with 4 practical activities directly mapped to NOSS C02 work activities (each activity 1-2 pages)
Competency rubric embedded with 4 levels (Not Yet, Partial, Competent, Advanced) and critical pass/fail safety criteria marked with [CRITICAL] tags
Mark schemes for each activity specify evidence requirements, observation points, and supervisor sign-off documentation format
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C02/PA.md (markdown with header box, TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN sections per Buku Panduan WIM)
File to reference: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C02/KK*.md to ensure PA activities match practical worksheet activities
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_bev_pa_rubric_format.py -v (validates: 4 activities, 4 competency levels, [CRITICAL] tags present)

stories.title: Create Aesthetic C04 Knowledge Assessment with Electrotherapy Safety and Contraindications Matrix
stories.description: Build KA for C04 covering all 6 electrotherapy modalities (EMS, TENS, Galvanic, Ultrasound, LED, Microcurrent), safety protocols, client contraindications, and equipment maintenance with embedded safety reference matrix.
acceptanceCriteria: KA.md created at aesthetic-services/C04/KA.md with 6 question sets (minimum 3 questions per modality) covering indications, contraindications, safety protocols, and equipment troubleshooting

Safety contraindication matrix embedded showing all 6 modalities vs. client conditions (pregnancy, cardiac, metal implants, skin conditions) with reference to medical literature or regulatory standards
Bilingual safety warnings (EN/BM) aligned to NOSS C04 safety requirements with [CRITICAL SAFETY] tags for high-risk content

stories.title: Build NOSS CoCU Work Activity Coverage Validator for All Subjects
stories.description: Create Python validator tool that parses NOSS CoCU extracts and matches each Work Activity to corresponding KK file, generating coverage report with gaps and unmapped activities.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script created at .spiral/validators/noss_coverage_check.py with CLI: uv run python .spiral/validators/noss_coverage_check.py --subject bev --output coverage-report.json
Output JSON report maps each NOSS Work Activity ID to corresponding KK file path with match confidence score (keyword overlap percentage)
Unmapped activities listed with NOSS text snippet and line number for manual review; report includes coverage percentage per CU and subject
technicalNotes: File to create: .spiral/validators/noss_coverage_check.py (Python ~120 lines with argparse CLI, JSON output function, keyword matching logic)
Files to reference: .spiral/data/noss-extracts/bev-noss-c01.md, .spiral/data/noss-extracts/aesthetic-noss-c01.md, it-computer-system/Level3/00-noss-extract.md for source NOSS data
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_noss_coverage_validator.py -v (validates: script_runs_without_error, output_json_valid, unmapped_activities_reported)

stories.title: Build Bilingual EN/BM Terminology Consistency Checker Across All WIM Documents
stories.description: Create validator that scans all KP/KT/KK/KA/PA/PM files against approved glossary JSON, reporting term mismatches, missing translations, and terminology drift (same concept, different translations).
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script at .spiral/validators/bilingual_consistency_check.py with CLI: uv run python .spiral/validators/bilingual_consistency_check.py --glossary _reference/glossary.json --subject all
Output CSV report with columns: term, file_path, line_number, glossary_approved_term, frequency_in_document, severity (error/warning)
Detects both missing BM translations and terminology drift (same English term, multiple BM translations); generates summary statistics per subject
technicalNotes: Files to create: .spiral/validators/bilingual_consistency_check.py (Python ~100 lines, CSV output function, glossary JSON parser, regex term matching)

Files to reference: _reference/glossary.json (JSON with structure {"en_term": {"bm": "bm_term", "context": "...", "aliases": [...]}}), all bev-diagnostic-rectification/**/*.md, aesthetic-services/**/*.md, it-computer-system/**/*.md
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_bilingual_consistency.py -v (validates: script_runs, glossary_json_parsed, csv_output_valid, drift_detection_works)

stories.title: Create BEV C01-C05 Knowledge Assessment Answer Key Generator with Diagnostic Decision Trees
stories.description: Build Python tool that auto-extracts answer schemes from KA markdown files, generates assessor answer keys with expected responses, mark allocations, and decision tree paths for scenario questions.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool at .spiral/tools/generate_ka_answer_keys.py with CLI: uv run python .spiral/tools/generate_ka_answer_keys.py --subject bev --output answer-keys.json
Output JSON includes: question_id, question_text, expected_answer, mark_allocation, answer_justification, decision_tree_path (for scenarios), rubric_criteria_alignment
Tool validates no orphaned questions (every question in KA has corresponding answer) and cross-references rubric levels against answer expectations
technicalNotes: File to create: .spiral/tools/generate_ka_answer_keys.py (Python ~80 lines with markdown parser, JSON output, validation logic)
Files to reference: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KA.md through C05/KA.md for answer extraction
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_ka_answer_key_gen.py -v (validates: all_questions_have_answers, json_output_valid, no_orphaned_questions)

stories.title: Build WIM Format Auto-Validator for Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020 Compliance Across All Documents
stories.description: Create comprehensive validator that checks every WIM document (KP/KT/KK/KA/PA/PM) for Buku Panduan compliance: header boxes, TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN structure, LANGKAH KERJA tables, SENARAI SEMAK checklists, 4-phase lesson plans, and bilingual headings.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator at .spiral/validators/wim_format_compliance.py with CLI: uv run python .spiral/validators/wim_format_compliance.py --path bev-diagnostic-rectification/ --output compliance-report.html

HTML report includes file-by-file compliance checklist with required elements per document type: KP (TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN), KT (BAHAGIAN structure), KK (LANGKAH KERJA tables), KA/PA (answer schemes, rubric), PM (4 phases: Pendahuluan/Pembentangan/Penyatuan/Penutupan)
Report shows compliance percentage per document type, lists non-compliant elements by file with line numbers, and provides a summary dashboard (overall compliance %, pass/fail per subject)
technicalNotes: File to create: .spiral/validators/wim_format_compliance.py (Python ~150 lines with HTML template generator, markdown header parser, regex pattern matching for Buku Panduan sections)
File to reference: _reference/wim-format-schema.json (JSON schema defining required elements per document type: KP, KT, KK, KA, PA, PM with regex patterns)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_wim_format_validator.py -v (validates: validator_runs, html_output_valid, compliance_percentage_calculated, non_compliant_elements_reported)
